column1: # exec/facts/node-record-layout.tsv: slot offsets of the per-node records modelgraphequality writes and nativeabi reads.
# kind = <record>.<variant>, name = the field, value = its slot inside the record (record width: NODE_FIELDS in
# nativeabi-gen-regions.tsv).  tools/facts-gen.cx turns each row into the scalar fact <record>_<variant>_<name> of
# exec/facts/node-record.tsv; the nets reference those, never the bare slot number.  Names in different
# record/variant pairs are independent even at the same slot.
#   fields.node -- the FIELDS area, one record per type node (mg_node / nc_node / nc_child / nl_node / nl_child).
#   fields.sig  -- the FIELDS area, the record of a callback signature node (nc_sig): slot 4 and 5 differ from node.
#   frame.walk  -- the FRAME area, the walk stack of modelgraphequality (mg_framelevel), pushed by MG.pushfields.
# FIELDS slots 1 and 2 are neither written nor read by these tables: no row.
# Not yet classified, left as bare numbers (writer state cannot tell node from sig) -- to verify:
#   (MG.rootbody .. MG.sigchildren) may write a sig record; and $r55 (sig slot 0, written from ms_byte).
#   exec/nativeabi/gen-result.tsv: nc_sig slot 0 (read into nc_v) -- the sig record's slot 0 has no named meaning yet.
